# JOURNAL — optimizer handover (append-only, whole run)

YOU (the optimizer) own this file. It is the running, accumulating handover across ALL iterations — accepted AND rejected — and it is NEVER reset. Each iteration you APPEND one new entry at the bottom (under the marker line); you do NOT edit or delete earlier entries. Read the whole journal before proposing, so you build on EVERY prior attempt (not just the last accepted one) and never re-test a refuted idea.

You CANNOT know your own gate result while you write — the harness scores you AFTER you stop and stamps a **RESULT** line (outcome + Δ + the tasks you measurably broke/fixed, plus the ones whose move was too small to resolve) right below your entry. So do NOT write 'what worked' as a guess. To learn what actually worked, READ the framework RESULT lines of prior entries (and LEDGER.md): an entry whose RESULT says `rejected` with `broke={...}` tells you which specific edits to drop or redesign — its diff.patch is in ./prior_iterations/<id>/.

Append your entry for THIS iteration below the marker, using this shape (INTENT only — the framework appends the RESULT):

    ## Iteration <your candidate id> — <one-line headline of what you tried>
    - Changes I made (1 line per edit; name the file/tool + cluster it targets):
    - Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe (which failing task it should fix;
      why no passing task changes behavior):
    - Building on prior RESULTS: which prior entries' broke/fixed I used, and what I
      did NOT re-try because a prior RESULT showed it regressed (cite ids):
    - Refuted hypotheses (a prior RESULT proved this is NOT the fix — never re-test):
    - High-value clusters still NOT cracked (and the guard/tool designs already tried):
    - Plateau signal (are the last few RESULTs flat/negative? if so, which LEVER to switch
      to — e.g. a NEW composite tool instead of another guard, or prompt instead of code):
    - Focus next iteration:

## Iteration cand_0001 — Establish core constraints and verification
- Changes I made:
  - prompt.md: added "Literal Values Only" section to forbid formulas.
  - prompt.md: added "Precision First" and "Untouched Cells" rules to prevent over-modification.
  - prompt.md: added "Verify" step to the Execution Workflow.
  - guidance.md: added detailed rules for Handling Data Types (datetime/float/int).
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - Forbid formulas: fixes 45635, 54144; safe because passing tasks don't use formulas.
  - Type correctness: fixes 416-15, 54144; safe because passing tasks use correct types.
  - Precision: fixes 54144, 38462; safe because passing tasks are already precise.
  - Verification step: helps catch all logic/format errors before submission; safe because it's a read-only step.
- Building on prior RESULTS: this is the first iteration.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Logic errors in complex Sheet-Level Manipulations (80-42, 227-40).
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Deep dive into logic failures for Sheet-Level Manipulation.

> **RESULT (framework, measured):** ACCEPTED (new champion) · val=0.725 Δ=+0.375 · fixed={37378, 38462, 39046, 416-15, 45635, 463-17, 46897, 53383, 54144, 55049, 55979, 56563, 59196, 6698, 7902, 8942, 9569} · broke={395-36, 50768} · unresolved={—} (moved less than 2·SE of its own measurement — NOT evidence the edit touched those tasks; do not redesign on them).

  - prompt.md: added "Strict Boundaries" rule to Output Contract to prevent over-writing.
  - guidance.md: added "Whole Numbers" rule to ensure counts/indices are explicitly cast to int.
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - Dry Run: targets logic failures (e.g., 51-12); safe as it is a read-only print step.
  - Strict Boundaries: targets range violations (e.g., 395-36); safe as passing tasks already obey boundaries.
  - Whole Numbers: targets type mismatches (e.g., 53647); safe as it only applies to whole-number results.
- Building on prior RESULTS: built on cand_0001's constraints; did not re-try any rejected edits as none were rejected in the prior iteration.
- Refuted hypotheses: none yet.
- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: Complex row-based logic (227-40) and multi-sheet consolidation (80-42) may still need more specific methods.
- Plateau signal: N/A.
- Focus next iteration: Deep dive into row-based logic methods.

- Changes I made:
  - prompt.md: added "Map" step to Execution Workflow to force source-target index validation.
  - prompt.md: clarified int vs float in Type Correctness.
  - guidance.md: added "Complex Logic Patterns" section with examples for temporal windows, open records, conditional mapping, and stateful iteration.
- Per change, the EXPECTED effect + why it's safe:
  - Map step: targets Range/Data Mapping cluster (80-42, 395-36); safe as it's an additive planning step.
  - Type clarity: targets Custom Calculation (53647); safe as passing tasks already use correct types.
  - Complex Logic Patterns: targets Windowing (37456, 43436) and stateful counting (51-12); safe as these are additive worked examples.
- Building on prior RESULTS: built on cand_0001 constraints; avoided re-trying cand_0002's "Dry Run" as it caused regressions in 31628, 402-43.

- High-value clusters still NOT cracked: None; addressed all 11 failing tasks this iteration.
